This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Novella">{{StoryCite|story=Hear Nothing, See Nothing, Say Nothing|book=Canto Bight (novella collection)}}</ref> [[Reek (Nihil)|Reek]]<ref name="THR7" /> and [[Neepers Panpick]] were both members of this species.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]]<ref name="Novella" /> was distinguished by their short stature, being roughly "[[Ewok]]-sized."<ref name="Reek" /> They had [[rodent]]-like features,<ref name="TLJ" /> capable of moving both quadrupedally<ref name="Reek" /> and bipedally. Their skin could be either [[Color|tan-pink]]<ref name="TLJ" /> or gray in coloration, with similarly colored [[hair]] sprouting from either side snout-like [[mouth]].<ref name="Reek" /> Additionally, they possessed large, glassy black [[eye]]s that bulged out of their skulls, as well as sizeable [[ear]]s.<ref name="TLJ" /> The species had the capacity to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="Novella" />

==Species in the galaxy==
[[File:Reek-2023THR7.png|thumb|left|160px|Reek, assistant to Baron Boolan of the Nihil]]
During the [[High Republic Era]], a member of this species known as [[Reek (Nihil)|Reek]] was found among the ranks of the [[Nihil]] [[pirate]]s, specifically within the service of the mad scientist [[Baron]] [[Boolan]]<ref name="Reek" /> as of [[229 BBY]].<ref name="THR7" /> A couple centuries later, another member of this species by the name of [[Neepers Panpick]] worked as a private detective on the planet [[Cantonica]].<ref name="Novella" /> During the [[First Order-Resistance War]] in [[34 ABY]], he was present at the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] in [[Canto Bight]] when the [[Resistance]] agents [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]] arrived searching for the [[Master Codebreaker]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:King_56.png|thumb|right|200px|King 56 by Ivan Manzella]]
The species made their onscreen debut in the [[2017]] film {{Film|VIII}}, directed by [[Rian Johnson]],<ref name="TLJ" /> though they were first mentioned in "[[Hear Nothing, See Nothing, Say Nothing]]," a short story from the [[Canto Bight (novella collection)|''Canto Bight'']] novella collection, written by [[Rae Carson]], which released shortly prior to the film.<ref name="Novella" /> They were originally designed by creature concept designer and sculptor [[Ivan Manzella]]<ref name="Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella - Creature & Character Designs|archivedate=20240604150100}}</ref> and titled "King 56."<ref name="art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref> Concept art created by [[MinJi Yoon]] for Reek, another member of this species, appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia event, first surfacing on [https://www.starwars.com/news/inside-the-high-republic-phase-3-nameless Starwars.com] in late [[2023]],<ref name="Reek" /> with the character finally appearing in [[The High Republic (2023) 7|''The High Republic'' (2023) 7]] around a half a year later.<ref name="THR7" /> According to the Keeper of the Holocron, [[Leland Chee]], as of [[April 1]], [[2025]], this species still did not have a name within the official [[Holocron continuity database]].<ref name="Unnamed Aliens">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-01|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1356720840036847656|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-Unnamed-Species-TLJ.png}}</ref>
